newsitem.title: HONG KONG: China's Ninghu Highway mulls HK listing -- report.
newsitem.headline: China's Ninghu Highway mulls HK listing -- report.

text.p: China's Ninghu Highway Company is planning to raise 3.0 billion yuan through an H share listing in Hong Kong, the Apple Daily said on Tuesday.
The company's only asset is the 274 km-long Huning Highway connecting Shanghai and Ningjing on which traffic started on September 15, the newspaper quoted informed sources as saying.

Proceeds of the new share issue, representing about 33.7 percent of the company's enlarged share capital, would be used to repay loans, purchase two toll roads and develop properties along the highways, it said.
The listing would be in early 1997 at the earliest, it said.
Ninghu planned to spend 2.0 billion yuan to purchase Jiangsu National Highway number 312 and participate in the development of Jingyin Highway project, the newspaper said.
About 500 million yuan was earmarked for loan repayment and the remaining 500 million would be reserved for developing commercial properties along the highways it held.
The company had 1.7 billion yuan long-term debt by the end of 1995 and its debt equity ratio was at 65 percent, it added.
Apple Daily said the company was in the process of selecting sponsors for the new share issue.
